param_input_item.param_description: a string: tar archive destination file. '.tar' is added when the name has no extension.
a character vector, a cell array of character vectors, or a string array: names of files or folders to archive. Wildcards '*' and '?' are allowed.
a character vector or string scalar: folder used to find relative names in files, and from which entry names are built (default: current folder).

param_output_item.param_description: a cell array of character vectors: sorted names of the entries written in the archive.

description.p: tar archives files and folders into a tar file. A folder is added with all its content.

The compression follows the extension of the archive name: '.tar.gz' or '.tgz' gives gzip, '.tar.zst' or '.tzst' gives Zstandard, '.tar.xz' or '.txz' gives xz, '.tar.bz2', '.tbz2' or '.tbz' gives bzip2, '.tar.lz4' gives lz4, '.tar.lzma' or '.tlz' gives lzma. Any other name gives a plain tar file.
zstd and xz compress on several threads (see maxNumCompThreads). gzip output has no date in its header: the same files give the same archive.
Archives are written in ustar format, with pax headers for long or non-ASCII names and for files larger than 8 GiB.
Ctrl+C stops the compression and removes the partial archive.
